description:
Submit an app built with AI to the Vibe Shipped review queue.

Use when: the user explicitly asks to list their app on Vibe Shipped and can give a public source (post, launch page or interview) showing which AI tool built it. Do not submit apps on someone else's behalf without their request.

Behavior: Write: stores a pending submission for human review; nothing is published automatically. Not destructive. Returns status pending, or isError with the validation message.

Example: {"title":"Habitly","url":"https://habitly.app","source_url":"https://x.com/maker/status/123","one_liner":"Habit tracker","tools":["lovable"],"builder_name":"Ana"}

source_url.description: Public post proving it was built with AI.

name: submit_app
title: Submit an app
